speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: That was no comedy. You walked like a man following a hearse, and then you stood.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He was dying.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Who?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am. In the second act.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: That is the most sensible thing you have yet done in a play. A man who dies in the second act has done his work. Sit.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I heard the walking from first light. I did not hear a joke. You stood so still the cat moved first.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Do not learn the speech. I am not giving you a side. The sorry in it is not for this table.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I do not want a side. I want to know if the bowl is still for him. He walked so long I thought the beef would go cold.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The bowl is beef, and it is hot, and the account is three pence. The loaf is still a finger and a half short, and the penny is still a penny. It has not grown since Tuesday.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not arguing the notch. About twenty lines, each this laid on the last, and then the turn. I am sitting.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: About twenty. And you are dead in the second act. I can bless a second act. I cannot bless a funeral before the bowl is down.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I was at my door. I did not come up. A man stops at the stair when the house is at its work.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You were right to stop. I walked it because I will have to breathe it in October. The house was only the house, which is the right size for a breath.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: October is not my quarter. Do not pay me in a month that is not due. Eat what is in the bowl.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: He stood, and the beef was still hot. That is a short standing after a long walk.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is a long speech and a short standing. I am. In the second act. I will not make it a grace before meat.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then let it be said, and let the meat be meat. I heard a writer. I prefer the writer when he sits. You are not at the playhouse.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not cast today. This one is at your board.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: A man at a board is a quiet neighbour. I am glad of the beef. I am not asking the name of the king.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Do not ask it. Two acts are enough for a Friday. I will not have a third act in the gravy.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two acts. Not the third. This floor is where I stood. I am not putting a king on the ground.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Then keep the hearse to the rug. I have washed the floor.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The rug is for feet. Three pence. That is the whole account. There is no other bill.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Three pence. Paid by sitting. The page is walked. I will not run it again at this table.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Walk it after nine and the broom will answer. You know the broom. Eat.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I will shut my door. The shuttle does not need a speech.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Shut it. I have said who is dying. I am not saying it twice.
